actual_coverage: Per instrument/case coverage below; no extrapolation outside completed probe times.

normalization_metadata.map_longitude_centers_deg: (CARRLONG + 1 + 2*i) mod360; validated against photospheric GONG WCS
normalization_metadata.holdout: Wind/OMNI never used to fit parameters
normalization_metadata.temperature_prescription: Tp(r0)=T400*(v/400)^2; gamma1.5 extrapolation from in-situ Tp
normalization_metadata.pressure: p=2 np kB Tp, assuming equal electron and proton temperatures
limitations: Scalar moments constrain normalization; density angular variation remains assumed constant n v^2.
Training contains compressions; ballistic inward extrapolation does not undo stream interactions.
Daily maps are retrospective time-interpolated boundary estimates; this is not an operational forecast.
Daily maps use historical synoptic far-side information, not simultaneous full-Sun measurements.
Single calibration interval and two spacecraft do not determine errors at the comet.

validation_training_separation: All native paired samples at or after the exclusive normalization training stop. Wind is entirely absent from normalization training.
frame: STEREO-A and Solar Orbiter observations are compared at their actual spacecraft ephemeris positions. Wind-selected OMNI2_H0_MRG1HR records (PLS1800=52) are already propagated near Earth and are compared at Earth (probe 1; Horizons target 399); no second L1-to-Earth shift, additional corotation mapping or fitted phase shift is applied.
cadence: Model native hourly means: COHO [timestamp,timestamp+1h]; OMNI [timestamp-0.5h,timestamp+0.5h], 1-minute trapezoid quadrature. In-house probe series interpolated between hourly outputs; CCMC between native approximately3.6-minute output.
caveats: Hourly in-house probe cadence smooths unresolved subhour variability.
STEREO-A/Solar Orbiter post-training samples provide temporal validation, while Wind supplies independent-instrument validation.
The boundary solar maps are retrospective; this is a hindcast and not an operational forecast.
Results are not calibrated to the comet or to CCMC output; residual errors constrain representativeness of the solar-wind estimate.

selection.author: Codex-root
selection.status: Final conditional CT reference; all selected finite numerical and exposure criteria pass
selection.selection_rationale: Finest completed physically/source-qualified nominal case. All four prospectively registered selected directional pairs pass original pointwise and separate PN exposure criteria, including latitude refinement at both radial baselines; baseline timestep/domain/spinup/moderate outer controls pass in their recorded scope. Earlier latitude/radial-exposure failures and unresolved physical controls remain explicit history. No empirical-accuracy or absolute-error guarantee.
selection.accuracy_scope: Conditional model estimate; recorded coarse controls do not establish all fine-grid interactions or empirical accuracy. Failed and unqualified physical responses are evidence, not uncertainty bounds.

qualification_at_selection.scope: Immutable selection-time evidence. Product pipeline independently refreshes current audits before deriving final products.
